info.title: Kiroku API
info.description: REST API for Kiroku Institutional Repository. Manages academic works (theses, dissertations, journals) with community/collection/item hierarchy, full-text search, SWORD v2 deposit, and OAI-PMH harvesting.

post.summary: Full deposit (binary upload or URL link mode)
post.description:
Create item with relations and files in a single request. Supports two modes:

**Mode 1: Binary file upload (multipart/form-data)** — files uploaded as form parts.

**Mode 2: URL link mode (application/json)** — files referenced by URL with `deposit_type: "link"`.

files[chapters].description: Chapter PDF files (multiple allowed, max 50 MB each)

multipart/form-data.example:
item[title]=Implementasi Deep Learning untuk Deteksi Objek
item[collection_id]=660e8400-e29b-41d4-a716-446655440001
item[item_type]=skripsi
item[abstract]=Penelitian ini membahas implementasi deep learning...
item[student_name]=Ahmad Rizki
item[student_id]=12345678
item[faculty]=Fakultas Teknik
item[department]=Teknik Informatika
item[language]=id
relations[authors][0][author_name]=Ahmad Rizki
relations[authors][0][sequence]=1
relations[advisors][0][advisor_name]=Dr. Budi Santoso
relations[advisors][0][advisor_role]=main_advisor
relations[keywords][0]=deep learning
relations[keywords][1]=deteksi objek
files[fulltext][0]=@skripsi.pdf
files[chapters][0]=@bab1.pdf
files[chapters][1]=@bab2.pdf

get.description: Returns an APP Service Document listing all communities (workspaces) and their collections (Col-IRIs).

application/atomserv+xml.example:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<service xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2007/app" xmlns:sword="http://purl.org/sword/2/">
  <workspace>
    <title>Fakultas Teknik</title>
    <collection href="http://localhost:4000/sword-v2/collection/ft-ti">
      <title>Teknik Informatika</title>
      <accepts>application/atom+xml</accepts>
      <accepts>multipart/related</accepts>
    </collection>
  </workspace>
</service>

post.description: Deposit an item into a collection. Accepts Atom XML (metadata only) or multipart/related (metadata + file).

application/atom+xml.example:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<entry xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom" xmlns:dcterms="http://purl.org/dc/terms/">
  <title>Implementasi Deep Learning</title>
  <dcterms:abstract>Penelitian ini membahas...</dcterms:abstract>
  <dcterms:type>skripsi</dcterms:type>
  <dcterms:creator>Ahmad Rizki</dcterms:creator>
</entry>

get.description: Returns a SWORD v2 Statement describing the item's lifecycle state.
OAI-PMH 2.0 harvesting endpoint. Supports verbs: Identify, ListMetadataFormats, ListSets, ListIdentifiers, ListRecords, GetRecord.

parameters.name: metadataPrefix
parameters.description: Metadata format prefix (required for ListIdentifiers, ListRecords, GetRecord)

parameters.name: identifier
parameters.description: Item identifier (required for GetRecord). Format: oai:kiroku.ac.id:<uuid>

parameters.name: set
parameters.description: Set specification filter. Format: com_<community_id> or col_<collection_id>

bearerAuth.description: Kiroku API token. Format: kiroku_<base64>. Supply via Authorization: Bearer <token> header or ?token=<token> query parameter.

example.error: Missing or invalid API token. Supply it via the Authorization: Bearer <token> header or the ?token=<token> query parameter.
